child_list.content: A Beautiful Park
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
This is a beautiful park. In the park, we can see many flowers and trees. Some are red. Some are pink. There are many birds in the trees. We can see a lake in the park. There are some small boats on it.

It’s Saturday. There are many people in the park. Some are walking. Some are playing games. Some old men are sitting under the big tree. Mike and Jim are playing basketball. Mary is reading a book near the lake. Two boys are running. Five girls are dancing. They’re very happy.

child_list.content: 美丽的公园
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
这是一个美丽的公园。在公园里，我们可以看到许多花和树。花儿有些是红色的，有些是粉红色的。树上有许多鸟。我们可以在公园里看到一个湖。上面有一些小船。

今天是星期六。公园里有很多人。有些人在走路。有些人在玩游戏。一些老人正坐在大树下。迈克和吉姆在打篮球。玛丽正在湖边看书。两个男孩在跑步。五个女孩在跳舞。他们都很高兴。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
